_open_items: COUNT mismatches (PARTIES 15372 vs 5533, ACCOUNTS 10 missing, ACCTSITES/USES From Date 16108/16170) are merge/dedup issues, not field mappings — handled separately.

OSR remaps (RELATIONSHIPS Subject/Object OSR + Source System Ref, ROLERESP OSR entityid_internalid_RR, CONTACTPTS Party OSR<-contacts internalid) are computed cross-source references — handled separately.

LOCATIONS address fields empty (mapped/approved) and RA_PROFILES DFF showing ACCOUNT values need investigation on generated output.
